purpose: Teach: 爐/駝/實/濤/鵬/鮖/鵝/蛎

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、火災現場の爐、つまり炉痕跡を、警察、鑑識されますね
lines.en: So in this case, the fire scene and the burn traces—the police would conduct forensic analysis on those, wouldn't they?
lines.style: Methodical, slightly hesitant. Testing each thought as it arrives. Quiet precision. Like he's organizing facts out loud and checking if they land right. Respectful attention.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、駝、つまり駱駝、ラクダの密輸事件にも対応されますね
lines.en: That's right. The police also handle smuggling cases—like the camel trafficking ring we dealt with last month.
lines.style: Measured, supportive tone. Confirming the connection easily. Patient rhythm, like he's walked this ground before. Warm without overexplaining.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、旧字「實」、つまり実印の偽造を、警察、鑑定されますね
lines.en: In this case, the old-form seal—the forged personal stamp—the police would authenticate it through investigation, correct?
lines.style: Careful articulation. Testing the logic gently. Slight pause before the question-mark phrase. Ren checking his own reasoning more than asking.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、怒濤、つまり大濤被害の救助も担当されますね
lines.en: Exactly. We also coordinate rescue operations during tidal surge incidents and major flooding events.
lines.style: Steady confirmation. No rush. Acknowledging the range without fanfare. Professional ease. The tone of someone who's seen many kinds of emergencies.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、密漁の希少鳥、鵬の関連事案を、警察、対応されますね
lines.en: And in this case, the poaching of rare birds—specifically the peng—that related incident would also fall under police jurisdiction?
lines.style: Growing confidence in the questioning. Still respectful of hierarchy but more engaged now. Eyes forward. Ren thinking out loud with Takeda as anchor.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、漁業の鮖、つまりカジカ盗難の取り締まりもされますね
lines.en: Yes. We also handle the seizure of stolen aquaculture stock—kajika fish theft, that kind of thing.
lines.style: Easy, practical. Listing responsibilities without ceremony. Still warm. The authority speaking plainly about what the work actually entails.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、家禽の鵝、つまりガチョウの盗難事件を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: So this case—the theft of domesticated geese—that would fall under police investigation as well?
lines.style: Steady now. Less tentative. Ren's rhythm has found its footing. Still precise, but with more natural flow. Genuine question, not just recitation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、旧字「蛎」、つまり牡蠣の養殖場の盗難もされますね
lines.en: We do. Even oyster farm thefts and aquaculture site break-ins fall within our purview.
lines.style: Calm affirmation. Slight warmth at the edges—acknowledging that yes, even this mundane thing matters. No condescension. The door stays open to more questions.
